# Tom's of Maine

> > Tom's of Maine is a natural personal care brand committed to sustainable, ingredient-transparent products including toothpaste, deodorant, and body care, founded on principles of corporate stewardship and environmental responsibility.

Tom's of Maine offers a comprehensive range of natural personal care products with detailed ingredient transparency and a strong commitment to sustainability. The company, founded by Tom and Kate Chappell, operates under a Stewardship Model and B-Corp certification, providing customers with information about natural ingredients, remedies, and wellness topics.

## Key Topics

- Natural personal care
- Ingredient transparency
- Sustainability
- Stewardship Model
- B-Corp certification
- Natural toothpaste

## Products & Ingredients

- [Whiten Plus Deep Clean Whitening Toothpaste, Peppermint](https://www.tomsofmaine.com/products/whiten-plus-deep-clean-whitening-toothpaste-peppermint): Natural whitening toothpaste featuring peppermint oil and silica for effective cleaning
- [Our Ingredients](https://www.tomsofmaine.com/pages/our-ingredients): Detailed ingredient sourcing, processing methods including fermentation and saponification, and transparency information for all Tom's products
